shipped_rows.title_o: Scaffolding Voluntary Summer Reading for Children in Grades 3 to 5: An Experimental Study

blind_target.title: Effects of a voluntary summer reading intervention on reading achievement: Results from a randomized field trial.
blind_target.evidence_quote:
We also compared the performance of control group students in moderate and high poverty
schools in this study with the two studies of READS that we were attempting to replicate. As
shown in Figure 5, in the initial studies, as in high poverty schools in this study, control group
students lost ground in the summer, d = - .07 (Kim, 2006) and d = - .08 (Kim & White, 2008).
blind_target.outcome_quote:
In the
Coyne et al. (2013) study, as in our study, differences in the response of comparison group
students explained the failure to replicate.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: The authors give an overall failure-to-replicate verdict for their study in the conclusions. Positive effects in high-poverty schools are discussed, but the central effect did not replicate in the full sample; the overall verdict governs.

prior_decision.location: Results > Differences in Control Group Performance, p. 34, lines 806-809
prior_decision.reason: The paper explicitly states that the randomized trial was designed to replicate two initial experimental studies of READS—Kim (2006) and Kim and White (2008)—making Kim (2006) an omitted replication target with a failed outcome.

luna_triage.reason: The randomized trial states it replicates two prior READS studies, explicitly identifies Kim (2006) as one, and compares current control-group summer loss against Kim (2006)'s report. The only supplied row is the separate Kim and White (2008) paper. The retested finding is summer learning loss among control students in the original READS trial.
